title: A preview comment that says what to look at
body:
The comment on each PR now gives more than the preview link:
- **Go straight to it:** a link into the preview for each `Where:` line, landing inside the scene, dialog, ride or season.
- **Answers a wish:** the visitor's own words, their name and street, and how long ago they asked.
- **Tags and size:** the tags the story log will give the change, the file count and +/−, and a note when it touches the other person's area, naming the files.
- **Nudges:** a note when there's no `## Story` section, when a change you can see has no `Where:` line (`Where: none` counts as saying so), or when the title mentions a wish but `Idea:` names none.

A new workflow, `preview-comment.yml`, writes the comment. It runs when a PR is opened or pushed to, and also when the description is edited, without rebuilding the preview. `preview.yml` no longer comments. The words come from `renderPreviewComment` in `scripts/story/lib.mjs` (tested), and `scripts/story/preview-comment.mjs` gathers the facts with plain Node, no install.

Tried against real PRs: #65 shows Jimmy's garden wish and a nudge about the missing Story section, #71 links to the garden in April, and #82 lists just its tags. This PR's own comment comes from the new workflow.

Mike: heads-up. The comment on your PRs will look different, and it will point out a missing `Where:`.

477 tests pass.

## Story

Idea: Make the preview comment useful.
Where: none
Tags: infra, story-log
Asked vs made: Asked what the preview comment could say. Built the four cheap ideas (links, the wish, tags and areas, nudges) and held back before/after photos for later.
Mike:
Note:
